from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class FinancialReport(BaseModel):
    """A single company's financial report with profit data."""
    company: str | None = Field(description="The company name in the report")
    total_profit: float | None = Field(description="Total profit amount from the consolidated income statement")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period, e.g., 'Q1 2024' or 'January-March 2024'")
    source_text: str | None = Field(description="The exact line from the document showing the total profit")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    financial_reports: list[FinancialReport]
